retained_failures: The preimplementation broad sweep unintentionally ran one passing predecessor evaluation and invoked argument-driven utilities without required inputs; exact outputs remain retained.
Two pre-candidate gates stopped without candidate creation on a historical latest-pointer defect and stale topology fixture; both failure receipts and superseded manifests remain retained.
The first post-candidate sweep exposed a successor latest-pointer defect in the completed BASELINE-0025 validator; the bounded successor rule and corruption tests pass.
The first source MCP wrapper set only the child runtime path, so verification stopped before launch; corrected source and package paths pass.
The first structured scan treated the retained zero-byte MCP failure as ordinary JSON and symbolic token roles as credentials; the classified rerun passes.

The first clean-clone validator sequence stopped because ignored dist bytes omitted the frozen public-v0.0.23 predecessor archive; the exact approved asset was downloaded and verified before the unchanged validator passed.
The first combined dashboard viewer response truncated its own two-image output; each exact PNG passed separate original-detail inspection.
The first post-clean-receipt test wrapper imposed an invalid 2.429-second ceiling and terminated before a result; the unchanged direct suite passed all 47 tests.
The first premerge audit draft bound the real-surface identity to the product receipt rather than the literal audited head; the evaluator blocked it and released no action.

The first final-audit milestone preflight used milestone-level status active for UNIT-005; the validator failed, no publication followed, and the one-field in_progress correction now validates without warning.
limitations: GitHub has no configured checks or required review for PR #24, so repository, clean-clone, direct product-surface, and public-state gates are authoritative.
